title: AddressBook
description: One toon's address book (#477, decisions/deck.md [contract] [typeahead] [address]): every thing of the toon's catalog a typeahead may pick, with its reference, its address where something can receive one, its kind, labels and where it comes from. The server writes it (GET /api/addresses/<toon>), the creator's VN events and the deck editor filter it in one typeahead each; whether an address is valid stays the core's on save (/validate). Edit this file, run `npm run generate` (server/schema/generate.ts writes the Rust, TS and PHP types), commit the outputs.

AddressKind.description: What an entry is – the one thing a typeahead filters by: an asker takes the kinds it may pick (a VN character event: character, persona, look; unlockLocation: location; an item event: item; a jump: chapter, group; setVariable: variable). character / persona / look are the levels of address.rs's `Target` (`character:<id>[.<persona>[.<look>]]`); location, item and chapter are referenced `<kind>:<id>`. Proposals the owner has not confirmed (#477): a chapter's group is referenced `chapter:<number>.<group>` (its `name` the label as an event stores it, the reference word a safe form of it) and a story variable `variable:<scope>.<name>` (scope = the owning toon or `global`; its `name` the variable as written in this toon).

OriginState.description: `published`: the newest version of the origin document is the published one; `draft`: a newer draft exists (or nothing is published yet), and the entry is the draft's.

LocaleText.description: Content text: locale → text (the one shape of authored text; pick a locale with the one locale order, server/schema/tables/locale-order.json).

Origin.description: The catalog document an entry comes from.

key.description: the document's entity key (`character:catpope`, `place:dom`, `chapter:catpope:3`) or catalog entry (`item:incense`)

AddressEntry.description: One thing of the catalog: its reference always, its address only where a receiver of its kind exists (decisions/deck.md [address]: there is no interpreter, sending a word somewhere needs a possible receiver of the same type).

ref.description: the reference – which thing; every entry has one, stable; what a typeahead picks and a document's fields are filled from: `character:catpope.human.default`, `location:dom`, `item:incense`, `chapter:3`, `chapter:3.intro`, `variable:global.coins`

address.description: the address – who hears a word, in address.rs's grammar, the same text as `ref`; only where a receiver of the kind exists: character and item (deck-space far.rs), persona and look (the show's addressing, `picks_up`). A location, chapter, group or variable has none: nothing receives a word sent there today.

name.description: its own id at its level (`default` for the look above, `3` for a chapter, a group's label, a variable as written in this toon: `coins`, `global.coins`, `toptoy.coins`): what a document's field holds

parent.description: the reference one level up (a look's persona, a persona's character); absent at the top

moods.description: a look only: the moods it has art for, in the document's order

AddressBook.description: The document: one per toon, versioned by the catalog it was built from.

address_book.description: the format's version (2: `ref` on every entry, `address` only where a receiver exists)

version.description: the catalog's version it was built from (the response's ETag)

source.description: the toon's source language: the second step of the locale order

entries.description: parents before their children; characters, locations, items, chapters (each followed by its groups), variables
